==============================================================================

This decensoring project took many hours of work, and it involved, manual tracing masks in GIMP, used EromangaInPaint for 1st pass decensoring, and manual tracing all edges in gimp for 2nd pass decensoring, AI helped but a lot of retouching was done manually, so if there is anything I missed drop it in the comments, I will correct it at a later time. (Do keep in mind that there are multiple artists with different art styles in this anthology, check the censored work first to see if it as artist wanted it or a decensoring error).

For future projects I will attempt them chapter by chapter instead of full book. I actually like Shoujo Kumikyoku Anthologies, so if there is a specific chapter worth decensoring, drop it in the comments.
